note.after_visit_summary: Your child has an ear infection in her left ear and a cold. We found a red, bulging eardrum with pus behind it. We will start amoxicillin 720 mg two times a day from the liquid 400 mg per 5 mL (9 mL twice a day) for 10 days, even if she feels better sooner. For pain and fever, you may give ibuprofen 160 mg (8 mL children's liquid) every 6 to 8 hours, or acetaminophen 7.5 mL every 4 to 6 hours. For fever, 7.5 mL of the children's acetaminophen is the right amount for her weight. She can return to daycare once she has been fever-free for 24 hours without medicine. Call us if the fever or pain is not better after 2 to 3 days of the antibiotic, or bring her in right away if you see swelling or redness behind her ear or if she is very hard to wake up. No follow-up visit is needed if she is back to herself in a few days, unless another ear infection happens in the next few months. Her baby brother does not need to come in unless he gets a fever or pulls at his ears.
